_how_to_use_this_file: Two prizes cannot be read off a scoreboard, so they are typed in here.
Add one object to 'entries' when a prize is triggered, then commit.
type    must be exactly 'The Pink Slip' or 'QB Down'.
team    the three-letter abbreviation, for example NYJ, KC, GB, LV.
date    YYYY-MM-DD, the day it happened. The FIRST one wins the prize
outright, and only entries on the same date split it.
week    the week it happened, a whole number from 1 to 18.
status  'confirmed' pays it. 'proposed' records it without paying.
detail  one short sentence. It shows on the page under the prize.
The build checks every entry and refuses to write if anything is wrong.
Example of a finished entry, to copy into the empty list below:
{ "type": "The Pink Slip", "team": "NYJ", "date": "2026-10-13", "week": 6, "status": "confirmed", "detail": "Head coach dismissed on the Monday after Week 6" }
void_games is for a game that is cancelled and will never be played.
Without it that week never counts as finished and every prize after it
would freeze for the rest of the season. Put the game id in the list,
for example "2026_07_BUF_CIN". Leave it empty unless it happens.
